title: Intention

  • 1. Cakkhuvagga 1. The Eye

Rūpasañcetanāsutta Intention

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpasañcetanā, bhikkhave, aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī; “Mendicants, intention regarding sights is impermanent, decaying, and perishing. saddasañcetanā … Intention regarding sounds, gandhasañcetanā … intention regarding smells, rasasañcetanā … intention regarding tastes, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā … intention regarding touches, dhammasañcetanā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. and intentions regarding ideas are impermanent, decaying, and perishing.

Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṁ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṁ vuccati ‘saddhānusārī …pe… Someone who has faith and confidence in these teachings is called a follower by faith. …” sambodhiparāyano’”ti.

Sattamaṁ.
